attractions.name: Pakshipathalam
attractions.description: For bird lovers, this Pakshipathalam trek offers a myriad of bird species on its 7 km stretch in the deep forests of Wayanad. The Forest Resort at Lanternstay provides guided tours through various treks; thus, it is family friendly and the adventures here are always safe and enjoyable. On this stretch, there are possibilities to sighting some rare species, such as Malabar Grey Hornbill and migratory birds
